title: Viettel Store: an AI sales assistant and live chat for the iPhone launch season
summary: An AI sales assistant combined with live chat, serving a very large number of customers during the iPhone pre-order season.

blocks.text: The iPhone launch season brings a very large number of simultaneous inquiries, which need fast, accurate product advice and a handoff to staff when needed.

items: Most customers are non-experts and ask mainly about stock, price and deposits.
Answers must be fast and consistent at peak hours.
The handoff between AI and staff must be smooth.

blocks.text: I was Product Owner: defining advisory scenarios, structuring the knowledge base, designing conversation flows and handoff rules, and monitoring quality after go-live.

items: Classify the questions customers ask most during the launch season.
Stock, price and deposit information is organized so the AI answers consistently.
Clear handoff rules for when exceptions need handling.
iPhone requests handled during the peak pre-order season

items: At peak hours, response speed and consistency matter as much as intelligence.
Handing off at the right moment is part of the AI product.
